title: From Regulations to Best Practices: Navigating the Complexities of the Healthcare Supply Chain
body_markdown:
*Originally posted on Modern Healthcare*


For hospitals and healthcare providers, safe and timely delivery isn’t just a logistics concern—it’s a matter of health and safety. In 2023, global medical supply expenses topped $146.9 billion, underscoring the critical need for a supply chain that is not only efficient but also secure, compliant and capable of rapid response.


Unlike other industries, healthcare logistics must account for regulatory oversight, temperature sensitivity, time-critical windows and the potential life-or-death consequences of a disruption. From diagnostic equipment and pharmaceuticals to personal protective equipment and surgical kits, what’s being transported can’t be replaced easily—or afford to arrive late.


[Click here](https://www.modernhealthcare.com/supply-chain/navigating-healthcare-supply-chain-challenges-best-practices-ensure-safe-compliant-and/) for more.
